name: Steel

description:
Steel is a lightweight Rust implementation of the Minecraft server.

Steel is still in BETA, so bugs can happen and some features are not implemented.

installation.script:
#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

echo "Downloading Steel"
mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "${VERSION:-}" ] || [ "${VERSION}" == "latest" ]; then
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/releases/latest/download/steel-linux-musl"
else
    DOWNLOAD_URL="https://github.com/Steel-Foundation/SteelMC/releases/download/${VERSION}/steel-linux-musl"
fi

echo "Fetching: $DOWNLOAD_URL"
curl -fL --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 300 --progress-bar "$DOWNLOAD_URL" -o steel 2>&1 \
    | tr '\r' '\n' \
    | awk 'NF && $0 != last { print; fflush(); last=$0 }'

chmod +x steel
echo "Installation successful"
exit 0
